en.bdb: Virtues of the Sikhs of Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਜਨਕ ਦੇ ਵਡਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: raaj jog hai janak dhe vaddaa bhagat kar vedh vakhaanai|

en.bdb: Janak is a king as well as a yogi and the books of knowledge describe him as great devotee.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਨਾਰਦ ਉਦਾਸ ਬਾਲ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਸੁਹਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: sanakaadhik naaradh udhaas baal subhai ateet suhaanai|

en.bdb: Sanaks and Narad from their very childhood were of detached nature and adorned themselves with indifference to all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਲਖ ਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: jog bhog lakh la(n)gh kai gur sikh saadhasa(n)gat nirabaanai|

en.bdb: Going beyond millions of detachments and enjoyments, the Sikhs of Guru also remain humble m the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਆਪੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: aap ganai viguchanaa aap gavaae aap sin(j)aanai|

en.bdb: He who gets himself counted or noticed goes astray in illusions; but he who loses his ego infact identifies his self.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਚ ਦਾ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਵਣਾ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh maarag sach dhaa pairee pavanaa raaje raanai|

en.bdb: Gurmukh' s way is the way of truth whereby all the kings and emperors fall on his feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਕੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਆਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: garab gumaan visaarikai gurmat ridhai gareebee aanai|

en.bdb: Treader of this path, forgetting his ego and pride cherishes humility in his heart through the wisdom of the Guru.
Such an humble person gets respects and regards in the true court.
